verificationScript:
from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/workspace/scratch/15bc3c358b41/rea-audit')
OUTPUT = ROOT / 'docs/verification/execution-authorization-2026-10-15.json'
SPEC = ROOT / 'docs/external-execution-authorization.md'
CATALOGUE = ROOT / 'docs/verification/execution-authorization-acceptance-2026-10-15.json'
DOCS = [
    SPEC, CATALOGUE,
    ROOT / 'docs/verification/execution-authorization-2026-10-15.md',
    ROOT / 'docs/fork-execution-readiness.md',
    ROOT / 'docs/provider-process-environment.md',
]
BASELINE = '1f4dc6996d452b62c3870ac1d3a7559461e698fd'
MAIN = '6060de329de9f3636f63e24a2419847fd9d3f889'

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()

checks = []
def passed(name, observation):
    checks.append({'name': name, 'status': 'PASS', 'scope': 'DOCUMENTATION_ONLY', 'observation': observation})

assert git('branch', '--show-current') == 'fix/bcode-rea-1-1-containment'
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') == BASELINE
assert git('rev-parse', 'main') == git('rev-parse', 'origin/main') == MAIN
passed('baseline_and_main', 'Evaluation HEAD and local/fetched main match the recorded revisions; no main write.')

catalogue = json.loads(CATALOGUE.read_text())
assert catalogue['baseline'] == BASELINE
assert catalogue['contractVersion'] == 'rea-evaluation-authorization/1'
assert catalogue['contractVersion'] in SPEC.read_text()
requirements = re.findall(r'\*\*(EA-R\d{2}) —', SPEC.read_text())
assert len(requirements) == len(set(requirements)) == 12
assert requirements == catalogue['requirements']
cases = catalogue['cases']
assert len(cases) == 28
assert [c['id'] for c in cases] == [f'EA-{i:02}' for i in range(1, 29)]
passed('catalogue_identity', 'Valid JSON; one version/baseline; 12 unique requirements and 28 unique ordered case IDs.')

covered = set()
for case in cases:
    assert set(case) == {'id', 'requirementIds', 'setup', 'action', 'expectedOutcome', 'oracle', 'currentStatus', 'runtimeEvidence'}
    assert case['requirementIds'] and set(case['requirementIds']) <= set(requirements)
    covered.update(case['requirementIds'])
    for field in ['setup', 'action', 'expectedOutcome', 'oracle']:
        assert isinstance(case[field], str) and case[field].strip()
    assert case['currentStatus'] == 'NOT_TESTED' and case['runtimeEvidence'] == []
assert covered == set(requirements)
assert {c['expectedOutcome'] for c in cases} >= {'ALLOW', 'DENY', 'AT_MOST_ONE', 'STOP_AND_DISPOSE', 'RESTRICTED_OUTPUT', 'DELETE_ACCESSIBLE_COPIES', 'BLOCK_PROFILE'}
passed('acceptance_traceability', 'All 12 requirements map to cases with setup/action/oracle; positive, denial, concurrency, cleanup, private-output and deletion outcomes are specified.')
passed('runtime_status_truthfulness', 'All 28 controller cases remain NOT_TESTED with no runtime evidence; no authorization PASS is inferred from this check.')

anchors = []
for anchor in catalogue['sourceAnchors']:
    source = ROOT / anchor['path']
    content = source.read_text()
    assert anchor['needle'] in content, anchor
    anchors.append({**anchor, 'firstLine': content[:content.index(anchor['needle'])].count('\n') + 1, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
passed('source_anchor_integrity', f'{len(anchors)} current source/test anchors exist; file hashes and locations retained without executing those files.')

prior_path = ROOT / 'docs/verification/direct-environment-2026-10-15.json'
prior = json.loads(prior_path.read_text())
assert prior['validation']['totalDistinctPassed'] == 445
assert prior['validation']['testSkipped'] == 8
assert prior['validation']['authorization'].startswith('OPEN:')
assert git('diff', '--name-only', 'HEAD', '--', str(prior_path.relative_to(ROOT))) == ''
passed('historical_evidence_scope', 'Prior saved 445-pass/8-skip record is unchanged and explicitly historical; its authorization status remains OPEN.')

allowed = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in DOCS + [OUTPUT]}
tracked_changes = set(git('diff', '--name-only', 'HEAD').splitlines())
untracked = set(git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard').splitlines())
assert tracked_changes | untracked <= allowed, (tracked_changes, untracked)
assert all(p.startswith('docs/') for p in allowed)
subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--exit-code', 'HEAD', '--', 'src', 'tests', '.github', 'package.json', 'package-lock.json', 'LICENSE'], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
passed('scope_preservation', 'Only the six declared document/data paths can differ; source, tests, workflows, package/lock and license are unchanged.')

links = 0
for path in DOCS:
    if path.suffix != '.md':
        continue
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)', path.read_text()):
        if '://' in target or target.startswith('#'):
            continue
        dest = (path.parent / target.split('#', 1)[0]).resolve()
        assert dest.is_relative_to(ROOT)
        assert dest.exists() or dest == OUTPUT.resolve(), (path, target)
        links += 1
passed('local_document_links', f'{links} relative document links resolve, including the evidence record produced by this command.')

subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--check'], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
for path in DOCS:
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    assert raw.endswith(b'\n') and not raw.endswith(b'\n\n'), path
    assert all(line.rstrip() == line for line in raw.splitlines()), path
passed('document_whitespace', 'Tracked diff and all five authored input artifacts have no trailing whitespace or extra EOF blank lines.')

record = {
    'timestamp': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'scope': 'DOCUMENTATION_ONLY',
    'baseline': BASELINE,
    'main': MAIN,
    'branch': git('branch', '--show-current'),
    'contractVersion': catalogue['contractVersion'],
    'checks': checks,
    'sourceAnchors': anchors,
    'artifactSha256': {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in DOCS},
    'recordHashScope': 'This output record cannot hash itself; the containing Git commit identifies its complete bytes.',
    'previousRuntimeEvidence': {'path': str(prior_path.relative_to(ROOT)), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(prior_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'rerun': False},
    'runtimeAcceptance': {'casesSpecified': len(cases), 'passed': 0, 'failed': 0, 'notTested': len(cases), 'externalControllerImplemented': False, 'newProjectTestsExecuted': 0, 'newCloudWorkersStarted': 0},
    'verdict': {'definition': 'SPECIFIED_AND_STATICALLY_CHECKED', 'externalEnforcement': 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED', 'runtimeAuthorization': 'NOT_TESTED', 'REA_1_1': 'PARTIAL', 'productionAndUnrestrictedAgents': 'NO_GO'},
    'verificationCommand': 'python /workspace/scratch/15bc3c358b41/verify-authorization-definition.py',
    'verificationScript': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    'reproductionNote': 'Extract verificationScript into a .py file outside the repository and run it with Python, adjusting ROOT to the checkout. Use a worktree of the stated baseline with these six documentation changes applied. It intentionally rejects a different baseline or extra changes. No REA code is imported or executed.',
}
OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
assert json.loads(OUTPUT.read_text())['runtimeAcceptance']['notTested'] == 28
print(json.dumps({'definitionChecks': [{'name': c['name'], 'status': c['status']} for c in checks], 'sourceAnchors': len(anchors), 'runtimeCases': {'PASS': 0, 'FAIL': 0, 'NOT_TESTED': len(cases)}, 'output': str(OUTPUT)}, indent=2))
